## Package set up

```{r packages, collapse = T, message=F, warning=F}
library(here)
library(haven)
library(tidyverse)
library(labelled)
library(flextable)
library(huxtable)
```

```{r load data}

# Load BSA teaching data
df <- readRDS(here::here("data", "synthetic_bsa2019.rds"))

df %>% 
  select(welfare2, leftrigh, libauth, RSex, RAgeCat) %>% 
  look_for()

```


```{r}

df2 <- df %>% mutate(brk = as_factor(RSex)) %>% select(-RSex)

mis_func <- list(
  n_miss = ~sum(is.na(.x)), 
  n_val = ~sum(!is.na(.x)),
  p_miss = ~sum(is.na(.x) / n() * 100),
  p_val = ~sum(!is.na(.x) / n() * 100)
)

mis_func$n_miss

brk_missingness <- df2 %>% group_by(brk) %>% summarise_all(
  list(mis_func[["p_val"]])
) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = - brk, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "val") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = brk, values_from = val)

total <- df2 %>% summarise_all(list(mis_func[["p_val"]])) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Total (all cases)")

  # per-group count of columns with at least 1 valid case
  n_cols_valid_by_brk <- df2 %>% 
    group_by(brk) %>% 
    summarise(across(everything(), ~ any(!is.na(.x)))) %>% 
    pivot_longer(names_to = "Variable", values_to = "any", cols = -brk) %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = brk, values_from = any) %>%
    rowwise() %>% 
    mutate(n_cols_any_valid = sum(c_across(-Variable))) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    select(Variable, n_cols_any_valid)
  
df2 %>%  group_by(brk) %>% 
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ any(!is.na(.x)))) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  summarise(across(-brk, sum)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "n_brk_levels_with_valid")

result <- full_join(brk_missingness, total)

n_labels_in_df <- var_label(df2, null_action = "skip") %>% length()

if(n_labels_in_df > 0){
result_with_label <- full_join(result, 
              labelled::var_label(df2, null_action = "fill") %>% 
                as_tibble() %>% 
                pivot_longer(cols = everything(), 
                             names_to = "Variable", 
                             values_to = "Label")
                    ) %>% 
  relocate(Label, .after = "Variable")

} else {result_with_label <- result}

result_with_label

df
```


```{r}

df_miss_brk <- function(data, brk, type = "n_miss", show_label = FALSE){
  
  mis_func <- list(
    n_miss = ~sum(is.na(.x)), 
    n_val = ~sum(!is.na(.x)),
    p_miss = ~round(sum(is.na(.x)) / n() * 100, 1),
    p_val = ~round(sum(!is.na(.x)) / n() * 100, 1)
  )
  
  if(!type %in% names(mis_func)) {
    stop("`type` must be one of: ", paste(names(mis_func), collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  df <- data %>% mutate(brk = as_factor({{brk}})) %>% select(-{{brk}})
  
  missing_by_brk <- df %>% 
    group_by(brk) %>% 
    summarise(across(everything(), mis_func[[type]])) %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = -brk, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "val") %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = brk, values_from = val)
  
  missing_total <- df %>% 
    select(-brk) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), mis_func[[type]])) %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Total (all cases)")
  
  result <- full_join(missing_by_brk, missing_total, by = join_by(Variable))
  
  n_cols_with_valid_cases <- df %>% group_by(brk) %>% 
    summarise(across(everything(), ~ any(!is.na(.x)))) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    summarise(across(-brk, sum)) %>% 
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "n_brk_levels_valid")

  result <- result %>% full_join(n_cols_with_valid_cases, by = join_by(Variable))
  
  
  if(show_label){
    df_minus_brk <- df %>% select(-brk)
    n_labels_in_df <- labelled::var_label(df_minus_brk, null_action = "skip") %>% length()
    
    if(n_labels_in_df > 0){
      result <- full_join(
        result, 
        labelled::var_label(df_minus_brk, null_action = "fill") %>% 
          as_tibble() %>% 
          pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Label"), 
        by = join_by(Variable)
      ) %>% 
        mutate(Variable = paste0(Variable, ": ", Label)) %>% 
        select(-Label)
    }
  }
  
  result
}

df_miss_brk(data = df, brk = RSex, type = "p_val")  
df_miss_brk(data = df, brk = RSex, type = "n_val", show_label = T)  
df_miss_brk(data = df, brk = RSex, type = "n_", show_label = T)  

```


```{r}
df_miss_brk <- function(data, brk, type = "n_miss", show_label = FALSE,
                         form = "df", export = NULL){
  
  mis_func <- list(
    n_miss = ~sum(is.na(.x)), 
    n_val = ~sum(!is.na(.x)),
    p_miss = ~round(sum(is.na(.x)) / n() * 100, 1),
    p_val = ~round(sum(!is.na(.x)) / n() * 100, 1)
  )
  
  type_labels <- list(
    n_miss = "number of cases missing",
    n_val = "number of cases NOT missing",
    p_miss = "percentage of cases missing",
    p_val = "percentage of cases NOT missing"
  )
  
  if(!type %in% names(mis_func)) {
    stop("`type` must be one of: ", paste(names(mis_func), collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  if(!form %in% c("df", "flx")) {
    stop("`form` must be one of: 'df', 'flx'")
  }
  
  df <- data %>% mutate(brk = fct_drop(as_factor({{brk}}))) %>% select(-{{brk}})
  
  missing_by_brk <- df %>% 
    group_by(brk) %>% 
    summarise(across(everything(), mis_func[[type]])) %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = -brk, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "val") %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = brk, values_from = val)
  
  missing_total <- df %>% 
    select(-brk) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), mis_func[[type]])) %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Total (all cases)")
  
  result <- full_join(missing_by_brk, missing_total, by = join_by(Variable))
  
  n_cols_with_valid_cases <- df %>% 
    group_by(brk) %>% 
    summarise(across(everything(), ~ any(!is.na(.x)))) %>% 
    summarise(across(-brk, sum)) %>% 
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "n_brk_levels_valid")
  
  result <- result %>% full_join(n_cols_with_valid_cases, by = join_by(Variable))
  
  if(show_label){
    df_minus_brk <- df %>% select(-brk)
    n_labels_in_df <- labelled::var_label(df_minus_brk, null_action = "skip") %>% length()
    
    if(n_labels_in_df > 0){
      result <- full_join(
        result, 
        labelled::var_label(df_minus_brk, null_action = "fill") %>% 
          as_tibble() %>% 
          pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Label"), 
        by = join_by(Variable)
      ) %>% 
        mutate(Variable = paste0(Variable, ": ", Label)) %>% 
        select(-Label)
    }
  }
  
  # Plain tibble path -- no huxtable work needed at all
  if(form == "df" && is.null(export)) {
    return(result)
  }
  
  # --- huxtable build, shared by form == "flx" and export != NULL ---
  
  brk_label <- data %>% 
    select({{brk}}) %>% 
    labelled::var_label(null_action = "fill") %>% 
    unlist(use.names = FALSE)
  
  caption <- paste0("Table shows ", type_labels[[type]], " crosstabulated by ", brk_label, ".")
  
  ht <- result |>
    huxtable::as_hux() |>
    huxtable::set_all_padding(1) |>
    huxtable::set_outer_padding(1) |>
    huxtable::set_font_size(10) |>
    huxtable::set_font("Arial") |>
    huxtable::set_number_format(huxtable::everywhere, huxtable::everywhere, value = huxtable::fmt_pretty(digits = 2)) |>
    huxtable::set_bold(row = 1, col = huxtable::everywhere) |>
    huxtable::set_bottom_border(row = 1, col = huxtable::everywhere) |>
    huxtable::set_na_string("na") |>
    huxtable::set_outer_borders(huxtable::everywhere, huxtable::everywhere, huxtable::brdr(1, style = "solid", "black")) |>
    huxtable::set_background_color(huxtable::evens, huxtable::everywhere, "grey95") |>
    huxtable::set_align(huxtable::everywhere, huxtable::everywhere, "left") |>
    huxtable::set_wrap(huxtable::everywhere, huxtable::everywhere, TRUE) |>
    huxtable::set_width(1) |>
    huxtable::map_text_color(huxtable::by_cases(is.na(.) ~ "red")) |>
    huxtable::set_caption(caption)
  
  col_lengths <- apply(ht, 2, function(col) max(nchar(as.character(col))))
  relative_widths <- col_lengths / sum(col_lengths)
  huxtable::col_width(ht) <- relative_widths
  
  if(!is.null(export)) {
    
    wb <- huxtable::as_Workbook(ht = ht, sheet = "missingness")
    
    # Caption occupies row 1, header row 2, data from row 3 -- since the
    # caption is now always set, this offset is no longer conditional.
    end_row <- 2 + nrow(result)
    end_col <- ncol(result)
    
    openxlsx::removeRowHeights(wb, "missingness", rows = 1:end_row)
    
    openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "missingness", style = openxlsx::createStyle(wrapText = TRUE),
                        cols = 1:end_col, rows = 2:end_row, gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
    
    openxlsx::removeColWidths(wb, "missingness", cols = 1:end_col)
    
    .col_width <- function(huxt) {
      header_row_char_length <- purrr::map_int(
        1:ncol(huxt),
        ~ tibble::as_tibble(huxt[, .x]) |> purrr::as_vector() |> stringr::str_length() |> max()
      )
      w <- header_row_char_length + 1
      w <- ifelse(w > 50, 50, w)
      w <- ifelse(w < 5, 5, w)
      w
    }
    
    col_widths <- .col_width(ht)
    openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "missingness", cols = 1:end_col, widths = col_widths, ignoreMergedCells = TRUE)
    
    # Freeze below the caption + header rows now that the caption always exists
    openxlsx::freezePane(wb, "missingness", firstActiveRow = 3, firstActiveCol = NULL)
    
    openxlsx::addStyle(wb = wb, sheet = "missingness",
                        style = openxlsx::createStyle(fontSize = 14, textDecoration = "bold", valign = "center"),
                        rows = 1, cols = 1)
    openxlsx::setRowHeights(wb, "missingness", rows = 1, heights = 30)
    
    openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb, file = export, overwrite = TRUE)
  }
  
  if(form == "flx") {
    ht <- ht |> huxtable::as_flextable() |> flextable::autofit()
  }
  
  ht
}

df_miss_brk(data = df, brk = RSex, form = "flx", type = "p_miss", show_label = T)

```
